description: One Anthropic message with a thinking block, then text, traced by OpenInference.
notes: OpenInference records message content by default, and this scenario sets no content-capture environment variable. The request enables thinking. The scenario model keeps Anthropic reasoning usage at 0, so the mock omits output_tokens_details. The thinking block is recorded as message_content.type reasoning with a signature, and there is no reasoning token attribute. Completion 16 is output_tokens copied.
